confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Phuket price levels, projected to a July 2026 window. No live listings, menus or booking pages were inspected. Food and drink anchors are moderately grounded in typical Thai tourist-area pricing. Accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July low-season rates. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.0 to 2.3 times beer) because direct knowledge of current bar menus is weak. USD values assume roughly 33 THB per USD; a materially different baht rate would move every USD anchor proportionally. The midrange meal anchor depends heavily on venue style, so expect a wide band.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Thai island and beach resort destinations such as Koh Samui and Krabi, with restaurant and drink levels in line with other Thai tourist centres. Accommodation reflects July low-season (southwest monsoon) rates rather than the December to February peak.
